caption_L1: This area graph is called Monthly number of visitor arrivals in Kenya from January 2019 to August 2020 , by airport. A linear scale of range 0 to 150,000 can be found along the y-axis, marked JKIA. A categorical scale starting with 2019 and ending with July can be found along the x-axis, labeled Month.
caption_L2L3: The highest number of visitors reached 150000 in the months either side of July. Number remained high until early 2000 when they fell to almost zero. The number of visitors started to increase again in July 2000 but were nowhere near previous number.
